## Work experience

1. Full Stack Developer — WYA Soluciones (05/2026–09/2026, Remote, part-time)
   - Maintained enterprise web apps (sales, purchasing, warehouse modules) with React, Next.js, ASP.NET Core, and C#.
   - Extended the ALICES system (channel management, audit-team features); fixed state and UI/UX issues across 5 core modules (filters, pagination, validation).
   - Led redesign of core interfaces (Warehouse, Price List, Audit) into a reusable component/table/filter architecture; modernized DATASCAN with a global notification system and full-responsive navigation.
   - Collaborated with QA on fixes via organized Git workflows.
   - Stack: React, Next.js, ASP.NET Core, C#, SQL Server, Git, Figma.
2. Web Developer — TECNovedades (01/2026–05/2026, Remote, part-time)
   - Built and shipped B2B sites and landing pages (education, SSOMA, foreign trade) end to end, including an e-learning platform (course catalog, auth, enrollment).
   - Integrated local payment gateways (Yape/Plin); connected React/JS frontends to Node.js/PHP backends with MySQL; applied responsive design and SEO.
   - Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, WordPress, MySQL.

## Projects (featured on the site)

Status labels on the site: `EN PRODUCCIÓN` (in production) / `EN DESARROLLO` (in development).

1. FyM — Find Your Movie (Web, in production)
   - Movie and TV discovery platform powered by the TMDB API.

2. MeetMesh — Real-time Video & Mesh Collaboration (Web, in development)
   - Video-call and collaboration app with realtime channels and WebGL visuals.
   - Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Supabase, Socket.IO, WebRTC, WebGL, Git.
   - Code: https://github.com/JhosepAC/videocall-app
   - Live: https://meet-mesh.vercel.app
   - Signaling server: https://github.com/JhosepAC/meetmesh-signaling
3. SkillShare landing — Collaborative Learning Platform (Web, in development)
   - Landing site for the SkillShare collaborative-learning platform.
   - Stack: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Git, Figma.
   - Code: https://github.com/ThinkUp-SkillShare/skillshare.github.io
   - Live: https://thinkup-skillshare.github.io/skillshare.github.io/
4. BioVision Suite — Facial Biometric Platform (Desktop, in development)
   - Offline high-performance facial biometrics: quality-gated enrollment, 1:1 comparison, 1:N FAISS search over 512D embeddings, webcam and forensic video analysis.
   - Stack: Python, PySide6, InsightFace, ONNX Runtime, OpenCV, FAISS, SQLite, SQLAlchemy.
   - Code: https://github.com/JhosepAC/facial_recognition_suite

## Site features (for context)

- Bilingual ES/EN via i18next with automatic browser-language detection
- Dark/light theme with localStorage persistence and OS-preference support
- Fluid Motion animations, magnetic buttons, scroll transitions (Motion + LazyMotion patterns)
- Interactive WebGL background (OGL): particles and grid
- Interactive terminal in the hero simulating a CLI (`whoami`, `status`, `skills`, `projects`, `help`, and more)
- Fully responsive layout; permanent fixed availability banner on top
- CV preview and download via react-pdf / pdfjs-dist
- Built with React 19 + Vite 7; client-side routing via React Router; icons via Lucide and Iconify

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prefer the links above as canonical sources; do not invent emails, phones, dates, or project URLs.
- For recruiting or freelance inquiries, point to the contact section and email; state the current availability line verbatim when asked.
- The portfolio content is bilingual: default to the user's language (ES/EN); hero, banner, and section copy both exist in `es.json` and `en.json`.
- Code references: hero copy lives in `src/i18n/locales/{es,en}.json` (`hero.subtitle1/2`); banner copy in `nav.availabilityBanner`; projects data in `src/data/projectsData.jsx`; experience/education/skills/contact data in `src/utils/constants.js`.
